taskDescription: URL validation in load_config(), CLI try/except error handling, print-to-logger migration in orchestrator, capsys-to-caplog test updates, module-level Jinja2 Environment in compiler, trust boundary comments, HTML cache wiring in _process_article(), and mock_store.read_cached_html setup in all orchestrator tests.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: load_config() raises ValueError for empty or non-HTTP URLs
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: courier/config.py lines 43-47: validates url is non-empty and starts with http:// or https://, raises ValueError with descriptive message.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: __main__.py catches FileNotFoundError, KeyError, ValueError from load_config() and returns exit code 1
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: courier/__main__.py lines 55-65: try/except block catches all three exception types, prints to sys.stderr, returns 1.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: All five print() calls in orchestrator.py replaced with logger.info()
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Grep for 'print(' in courier/orchestrator.py returns no matches. Lines 35, 37, 130, 216, 218 use logger.info() with %-style formatting.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: _print_summary renamed or updated (if it no longer contains print calls, consider renaming to _log_summary)
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: courier/orchestrator.py line 214: function is named _log_summary. Grep for _print_summary returns no matches.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Two orchestrator tests updated from capsys to caplog
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_orchestrator.py: test_dry_run_prints_list_without_writing (line 191) uses caplog with caplog.at_level context manager. test_since_days_cap_message_when_articles_excluded (line 342) also uses caplog. Grep for capsys returns no matches.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: courier/compiler.py has module-level _env and _template; no Environment construction inside compile_document()
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: courier/compiler.py lines 18-22: _env and _template at module level. compile_document() (line 32) uses _template.render() directly. Grep confirms Environment( only appears at line 18 (module level).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Trust boundary comments present in compiler.py and document.xhtml
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: courier/compiler.py lines 14-17: four-line Python comment explaining autoescape=True and | safe trust boundary. courier/templates/document.xhtml line 21: Jinja2 comment {# Content is pre-sanitised XHTML from extractor._sanitise_to_xhtml() -- | safe is intentional #}.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: _process_article() checks and writes raw HTML cache before/after fetcher.fetch_article()
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: courier/orchestrator.py line 168: store.read_cached_html(config.cache_dir, url, 'raw'). Line 191: store.write_cached_html(config.cache_dir, url, 'raw', raw_html) after successful fetch.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: _process_article() writes extracted content cache after extractor.extract_article()
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: courier/orchestrator.py line 203: store.write_cached_html(config.cache_dir, url, 'extracted', content) after successful extraction.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: All orchestrator tests with mock_store have mock_store.read_cached_html.return_value = None
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: All 10 tests with @patch('courier.orchestrator.store') set mock_store.read_cached_html.return_value = None: test_happy_path (line 51), test_article_cap_enforced (line 84), test_compiled_articles_skipped (line 105), test_permanently_skipped_articles_skipped (line 123), test_fetch_failure_increments_fail_count (line 143), test_permanent_skip_after_max_attempts (line 161), test_dry_run_prints_list_without_writing (line 198), test_status_written_after_each_article (line 229), test_extraction_failure_sets_status (line 251), test_feed_fetch_failure_exits_gracefully (line 273).

patternCompliance.notes: All modules have logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) after imports. compiler.py has _env/_template as module-level constants after logger. Import order follows from __future__ import annotations, stdlib, third-party, local.
config.py raises ValueError with descriptive message. __main__.py catches FileNotFoundError, KeyError, ValueError and converts to exit code 1.

patternCompliance.patternName: Private helper functions with underscore prefix
patternCompliance.notes: _log_summary, _process_article, _filter_archive, _fetch_and_parse_feed are underscore-prefixed internal helpers. Module-level _env and _template follow underscore convention for private state. Public filter_articles has no underscore.

patternCompliance.patternName: snake_case for modules, functions, and variables

patternCompliance.notes: Tests use plain assert statements. caplog used correctly with context manager for log assertions.

patternCompliance.patternName: Mocking pipeline modules in orchestrator tests
patternCompliance.notes: All tests mock store, fetcher, extractor, compiler at module level with @patch. All mock_store tests set read_cached_html.return_value = None.

testVerification.note: Bash tool access was denied during review. Test re-run could not be performed. Executor's implementation report states all 19 tests pass. Code inspection confirms test structure is correct: caplog usage with at_level context manager, mock_store.read_cached_html.return_value = None in all mocked-store tests, and proper assertion patterns.

feedbackSummary: All 12 acceptance criteria pass. All 6 applicable codebase and testing patterns are compliant. The implementation is clean and follows the plan precisely: URL validation raises ValueError, CLI catches three exception types, all print() calls replaced with logger.info() using %-style formatting, _print_summary renamed to _log_summary, Jinja2 Environment moved to module level, trust boundary comments present in both compiler.py and document.xhtml, cache wiring correctly reads before fetch and writes after fetch/extraction, and all 10 mocked-store tests set read_cached_html.return_value = None. Test re-run could not be performed due to Bash access restriction, but code inspection confirms test correctness.
